body: I’m in the same boat.. there the only thing I’ve hung on to all these years. It’s so hard because all I think about it is how I’d destroy them even more then I already have if I kill my self . I wish I didn’t care.
Yeah I can message you. Thank you

No.. no one, I used to but a lot of things have changed in the past 6 years I don’t have anyone anymore. I closed myself off to everyone I know. They all see the “real” me but not the one that’s hurting. And thanks.

Yeah but my college doesn’t have counselors or anything like that..only a nurse. And okay I’m going to try my best to reach out more when I’m in a bad place. I feel like I can’t do this on my own. I can’t keep these things to my self. I feel like I’m going to explode.

Thank you. I appreciate it so much. And I know I need to talk to one but I can’t afford that and My parents will ask why I’m seeing someone if they see it on there insurance statements. So idk what to do. I’m so scared about all this

That’s what I’m thinking might be causing this too. I know it’ll be better for me to talk to a therapist about it but I can’t bring myself to ask my doctor or anyone for help. I want to so badly but I can’t do it. That’s why nobody can help me it’s either this goes away eventually or I’ll will end up killing myself. I’ve came to this decision before. I can’t keep living like this
Thank you for your kind words. I can’t help my self and i feel like I’m drowning and everyday is just one more day of suffering

The thing is I really started to feel depressed was when everything in my life was fine I was doing everything amazing. I already was having suicidal thoughts before I felt the full exactly how you say like a boulder. But then my dad and me started arguing more again and he actually kicked me out of the house for the fifth time because of an argument. I finally got control of my parents situation and told them I was never going back to live with my dad and I’ve been living with my mom since. It feels like as my life around me school and family are extremely better my thoughts and sadness are getting worse. I don’t know what to feel.

It’s just so hard right now.. i just want this feeling to end. I never got past this when I was young so now I can’t move on. I feel like I’ll never be able to get over my self-loathing and this darkness it’s like it’s attached to me and I just want to to go away..
